preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 10**6 for S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string S in the test cases has a length between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The sum of the lengths of all strings S in the test cases does not exceed 10^6.
Each string S in the test cases consists only of lowercase english alphabets.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(result == -1 or (1 <= result <= len(S)) for result, S in zip(results, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each result is either -1 or a length between 1 and the length of the corresponding string S inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 or (not any(S.startswith(P) for P in substrings(S) if len(P) > 0)) for result, S in zip(results, test_cases))
postconditions.description: If the result is not -1, no non-empty substring of the found string P is a prefix of S.

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 or (not any(S.endswith(P) for P in substrings(S) if len(P) > 0)) for result, S in zip(results, test_cases))
postconditions.description: If the result is not -1, no non-empty substring of the found string P is a suffix of S.

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 or (result == max(len(P) for P in substrings(S) if all(not S.startswith(P[:i]) and not S.endswith(P[:i]) for i in range(1, len(P)+1)))) for result, S in zip(results, test_cases))
postconditions.description: If the result is not -1, it is the length of the longest substring P of S such that no non-empty substring of P is a prefix or suffix of S.
